dialogue.text: Are you saying I don't support you?

dialogue.speaker: orange
dialogue.text: You know I love you, right? I tell you all the time how proud I am of you. Now I feel like I'm the bad blobfriend… I was only joking around, I didn't mean anything by it.

choices.text: I know you were just teasing.
I didn't mean to make you feel bad.

glossary.label: What is DARVO?
glossary.body: DARVO (Deny, Attack, Reverse Victim & Offender) is a manipulation tactic where an abuser denies their behavior, attacks the person confronting them, and flips the narrative to make themselves look like the actual victim.
